raw_segments.text: But when the Spaniards and Portuguese of South America begin to feel the wants common to
all civilized nations, they will still be unable to satisfy those wants for themselves.

They will be agriculturists long before they succeed in manufacturers or commerce, and
they will require the mediation of strangers to exchange their produce, beyond seas for
those articles, for which a demand will begin to be felt.
